# `<dev/protocols/fb.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Framebuffer protocol served by gfxsvc ("/svc/gfx").

One client at a time owns the display. It asks for the framebuffer with FB_CMD_GET_BUF, draws into the mapped images, and shows one with FB_CMD_FLIP.

```c
#include <dev/protocols/fb.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fb_cmd_get_info"></a>`FB_CMD_GET_INFO` | `1` | Ask for the display's geometry. Request {cmd}; replies [FbInfo](#fbinfo). |
| <a id="fb_cmd_get_buf"></a>`FB_CMD_GET_BUF` | `2` | Take ownership of the framebuffer. Request {cmd}, granting a port the caller owns (PERM_WAIT \| PERM_TXFR); the display drops ownership when that port dies. Replies [FbInfo](#fbinfo) and grants a PERM_MAP \| PERM_WRITE \| PERM_TXFR duplicate of the framebuffer. ERR_BUSY if someone else owns it. |
| <a id="fb_cmd_release"></a>`FB_CMD_RELEASE` | `3` | Give up ownership. Request {cmd, token}; replies {[Err](../../../errors.md#err) status}. |
| <a id="fb_cmd_set_event"></a>`FB_CMD_SET_EVENT` | `4` | Give gfxsvc an event to signal. Request {cmd, token}, granting the caller's own event (PERM_SEND \| PERM_TXFR). The driver signals FB_EVT_* bits on it. Replaces any previous event. |
| <a id="fb_cmd_flip"></a>`FB_CMD_FLIP` | `5` | Show another image. Request {cmd, token, arg = image index}. Scanout switches to that image at the start of the next frame, and the reply does not wait for that. FB_EVT_FLIPPED fires once it has, which means the previously shown image is free to draw into. ERR_BUSY if a flip is pending, ERR_BADARG for a bad index. |
| <a id="fb_cmd_set_vsync"></a>`FB_CMD_SET_VSYNC` | `6` | Turn vertical-sync events on or off. Request {cmd, token, arg = 0 or 1}. While enabled the driver signals FB_EVT_VSYNC every frame. |
| <a id="fb_evt_vsync"></a>`FB_EVT_VSYNC` | `(1u << 0)` | Event bit: a frame was scanned out (while FB_CMD_SET_VSYNC is on). |
| <a id="fb_evt_flipped"></a>`FB_EVT_FLIPPED` | `(1u << 1)` | Event bit: a requested flip took effect. |
| <a id="fb_fmt_rgb565"></a>`FB_FMT_RGB565` | `1u` | Pixel format: 16 bits per pixel, red in bits 15 to 11, green in 10 to 5, blue in 4 to 0. |

## Structures

### `FbRequest` { #fbrequest }

A request to gfxsvc.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | An FB_CMD_* value. |
| `token` | `uint32_t` | Ownership token from FB_CMD_GET_BUF; 0 for FB_CMD_GET_INFO. |
| `arg` | `uint32_t` | Command argument, if the command takes one. |

### `FbInfo` { #fbinfo }

gfxsvc's reply to FB_CMD_GET_INFO and FB_CMD_GET_BUF.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`Err`](../../../errors.md#err) | ZUZU_OK, or an error code. |
| `width` | `uint32_t` | Width in pixels. |
| `height` | `uint32_t` | Height in pixels. |
| `stride` | `uint32_t` | Bytes from one row to the next. |
| `format` | `uint32_t` | An FB_FMT_* value. |
| `buffers` | `uint32_t` | Images in the memory object; 1 means no double buffering. |
| `buf_size` | `uint32_t` | Bytes per image, a whole number of pages. |
| `token` | `uint32_t` | FB_CMD_GET_BUF only: ownership token; 0 otherwise. |
